notes: SignaturePlugin v2.9.0 adds an overlay size setting and narrows the default overlay. The size slider needs engine v2.2.0 or later; on an older engine the same setting shows as a number box. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.8.0.
changes: Added: A Size setting under Overlay shrinks the whole overlay, text included, down to half its size, with a slider in the plugin settings.
Changed: The default overlay is narrower, since it was much wider than any reading needs.
